title: vfx power language (version 1)
description: data/vfx/power.json: VFX's power language (docs/vfx/power-language.md): visual ways to show a higher tier without more speed. Today it holds one prototype, the levitating rocks (render/vfx/rocks.gd), behind the hub flag rocks_enabled (default off); a new idea adds a group here and a line to this schema. Presentation only: never read by the sim. Version field: version. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Every key is optional because rocks.gd falls back to the same default. Lengths are in fighter heights (_bh, 75 units), times in seconds, drift in radians a second. Pairs where the minimum must not exceed the maximum, and counts above the 12 pieces rocks.gd keeps, are checked by tools/lib/xref.js (vfx-power-range).

rocks.description: Levitating rocks: chunks of the ground's own earth hang loose about a standing or hovering fighter, drifting slowly and bobbing a little (idea 1 of the list).

min_tier.description: The lowest power tier that shows them.

h_min_bh.description: Height above his feet, in fighter heights; a little negative lets a rock sit below them.

near_ground_bh.description: They show only within this height of the ground.

max_speed_bh.description: They hide above this speed of the fighter, in fighter heights a second.
